references.text: Psalm 127:1 also compares building on a solid foundation with God's protection and blessing, similar to the wisdom mentioned in Matthew 7:24.
Proverbs 10:25 mentions the eternal foundation of the righteous, which can be seen as parallel to the wise man's action in Matthew 7:24.
Isaiah 28:16 speaks of a cornerstone, a firm foundation, which can be associated with the solid foundation in Matthew 7:24.
Hebrews 6:1-2 urges moving forward to maturity, not laying another foundation, which relates to building one's life on Christ's teaching, as in Matthew 7:24.
Ephesians 2:20-22 describes believers as built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the cornerstone, parallel to building on a solid base in Matthew 7:24.
Matthew 16:18, where Jesus speaks of building his church on the rock, can be seen as a spiritual parallel to the wise construction in Matthew 7:24.
